scope: Season 1 launch activation planning and asset pipeline only; no ads, no paid audio, no publishing, no production metadata mutation.

release_truth_summary.book_2b9853ec52_status: Production book API 200, reader shell 200, manifest 200, audiobook endpoint 200, audio/sidecars 200, go-live evidence published=true.
release_truth_summary.a_ghost_story_status: Local controlled-publication evidence marks audiobook_release_gate=APPROVED and audio assets resolve 200; production reader/book routes return app shell 200. Guessed public API manifest/audiobook paths returned 404, so paid listen ads should use reader route and require one final browser/manifest confirmation before spend.
release_truth_summary.non_live_tier_1_rule: May be described only as coming soon, in production, or selected for the Founding Audiobook Lot. No Listen CTA.

activation_sequence: Publish Season 1 positioning internally and align public copy to release-truth matrix.
Use the 14-day asset pack for organic posts only.
Use audio teasers only for book-2b9853ec52 and a-ghost-story after final route check on the asset being clipped.
Route non-live audiobook candidates to Read or Coming Soon CTAs only.
Delay paid ads until at least 4-6 audiobooks are live, except a tiny reader-first validation test.

asset_pipeline.live_audio_assets: 15s and 30s clips are eligible only for approved live audiobooks.
asset_pipeline.candidate_assets: Cover reveal, quote card, reader excerpt, quality-gate story, poll, and coming-soon card.
asset_pipeline.reader_first_assets: Reader challenge, classroom/culture posts, cover-led posts, and nostalgia prompts.
asset_pipeline.tracking: First-party events only unless REACT_APP_ENABLE_POSTHOG=true or equivalent config explicitly enables third-party tracking.

validation_summary.release_truth_status: PASS_FOR_DOCS; safe copy generated; no unapproved Listen CTA in docs
